sample_selection: lowest SHA256('MA-EXIT4-v1|'+market+':'+symbol), independent of price performance; current provider common-share universe
entry: previous completed close: SMA5>SMA10>SMA20>SMA60; SMA20>SMA20[-5]; close/close[-63]>=1.20; close>=0.90*highest close of last63. Three consecutive qualifying closes. Next tradable open starts a fully held unit. No entries overlap a 126-session cycle for a symbol. This is an exit-only proxy, not the user's buy process or 20:30:50 simulated buys.
execution: close signals, next tradable session open; volume>0 and high>low required; at most one original-position tranche per session, pending order carried; no rebuy; unfinished holdings marked at horizon close, not a fabricated fourth sale
train_validation_purge: entire126-session cycle plus60-session outcome followup must end within its split
cost_note: All-in research scenarios, not assertions about statutory taxes or a user's broker; includes assumed spread, fee, slippage and KR extra selling burden. Also evaluate zero, double and 1-session-late execution.
refine: Best six distinct timing policies by training composite, then all84 positive10%-grid four-part compositions plus25/25/25/25; no new timing family after validation.
selection: All training finalists ranked on training and validation separately. 0.4*training_score+0.6*validation_score. Five distinct timing finalists frozen before reading test outcomes. Recommend highest combined score; tie to1e-8 uses fewer conditions, then lexicographic ID.
aggregation: Within each split, average cycles per symbol first, then symbols per market, then KR/US equally. Return input winsorized to[-100%,300%] solely for optimization; report raw returns too. All other metrics raw. Ranking percentiles computed only among training-refined candidates at selection.
confidence: 2000 paired symbol-cluster and entry-quarter-cluster bootstrap replicates, market stratified for symbol bootstrap; dependence warning for their intersection; Holm-adjusted one-sided fixed-test comparisons of5 frozen finalists vs buyhold, no retuning from test.
primary_success: 20 sessions after actual sale execution: net sale proceeds per sold share greater than that future closing price. Weighted by sold original-position fractions; unfilled stage is not a successful sale. 5/60 sessions also reported.
primary_expected_pnl: sold-fraction*(net execution price - close at execution+20)/initial cost. Signed and equal to avoided terminal decline minus missed terminal rise. Future extrema are separate potential metrics and must not be subtracted to manufacture expected profit.
limitations_fixed: provider-adjusted OHLC not dividend reinvested total return
fully-held exit-only proxy, not real recorded buys
no portfolio capital allocation, reinvestment or FX return
fractional holdings for research; integer shares can prevent four positive actual fills
